stem_book: When a car passes mark-A, driver applies brakes. Thereafter reducing speed uniformly from 160 km/h at A, the car passes mark C with a speed 40 km/h. The marks are at equal distance on the road as shown below. Where on the road was the car moving with a speed 100 km/h? Neglect the size of the car as compared to the distance involved. (a) At mark-B (b) Between mark-A and mark-B (c) Between mark-B and mark-C (d) Information is insufficient to decide.
work: uniform deceleration: v_B² = (160² + 40²)/2 = 13600 → v_B ≈ 116.6 km/h > 100 → 100 km/h reached after B
